author: kravetsone
abstract: Turns a product spec (Google Docs / Notion / PDF ТЗ) plus a Figma file into a senior-level backend plan: API contract, data model, race-condition register, analytics event spec, and a sequenced backlog. Runs a staged pipeline with deliberate model tiering — a script reduces Figma to a digest, a cheap model builds the requirement and screen ledgers, and an expensive model does only the architecture — separated by two human gates (facts, then architectural decisions). Opinionated monolith stack: Bun + Elysia + Drizzle + PostgreSQL + Redis, GramIO for Telegram bots, @verrou/core for locks, env-var for configuration, taskora for jobs/schedules/flow-control, OpenTelemetry through @elysiajs/opentelemetry, PostHog for product analytics, bun:test + PGlite for tests. Treats concurrency as a first-class deliverable: a hotspot register where every entry must be closed by a database-level mechanism (conditional UPDATE, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, unique-constraint idempotency, outbox/inbox) because Verrou locks carry no fencing token and cannot by themselves hold an invariant. Ships 7 zero-dependency Node scripts (plan-init, docs-pull, figma-digest, merge-facts, hotspot-scan, plan-lint, coverage-report), a 12-group anti-pattern linter distilled from two real production services, corrected paste-ready templates for every pattern it recommends, and a platform contract that pins the exact environment-variable names a GitLab CI + ArgoCD + sealed-secrets deployment injects.
